answer: Sealed-vault storage proofs: each fake costs a unique 4 GB vault plus ~2 h of sequential sealing. Every epoch a random ripple of audits hits each agent: open 16 random sectors within 2 s, each answer seeding the next index, so resealing on demand is far too slow and a mismatch rejects the ID. Credit equals the nadir (lowest) proven capacity over 30 epochs, so a farm cannot rotate one disk across aliases; 1,000 fakes need 4 TB held continuously and 2,000 sealing hours.
